seoTitle: Copy and Paste in Smartsheet Without Breaking Formulas
metaDescription: Copy cells, full rows, or entire sheet structures in Smartsheet while preserving formulas, hierarchies, attachments, and conditional formatting.
intro: Copy-paste in Smartsheet works differently depending on whether you're moving a few cells, a full row with attachments, or an entire sheet architecture. This guide covers the standard keyboard shortcuts, the Copy Row to Another Sheet feature, and the Save as New command for full sheet duplication.

steps.heading: Use standard cell copy-paste
steps.body: Use Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V (or Cmd+C and Cmd+V on Mac) for basic cell-to-cell copying.

steps.heading: Bulk-copy across rows or into Excel
steps.body: Copy larger data blocks and paste them across multiple rows, or into external apps like Excel, without breaking formatting.

steps.heading: Move full rows with Copy Row to Another Sheet
steps.body: Use this native feature to push entire rows, including attachments and comments, into a separate tracking sheet.

steps.heading: Duplicate a whole sheet with Save as New
steps.body: Clone your columns, conditional formatting, and forms, choosing whether to include or clear the underlying cell data.

steps.heading: Verify hierarchies and formulas afterward
steps.body: Check that parent-child indentation and cross-sheet formula links carried over correctly after the transfer.

faq.question: Can I copy an entire row including its attachments?
faq.answer: Yes, the Copy Row to Another Sheet feature moves full rows, attachments, and comments into a separate sheet.

faq.question: How do I duplicate a whole sheet, including its formatting?
faq.answer: Use the Save as New command, which lets you clone columns, conditional formatting, and forms while choosing to keep or clear cell data.

faq.question: Will pasting break my parent-child row hierarchy?
faq.answer: Preserving indentation structures during a paste is something to watch for, especially when moving tasks between grids.

faq.question: Can I paste Smartsheet data into Excel cleanly?
faq.answer: Yes, bulk copy-paste works into external applications like Microsoft Excel without formatting breaks in most cases.
